_about: Where the installer looks for saved copies, in this order (Jake 11/23 12:40 AM CT, Decision 30 A). The first copy whose bytes match the pinned sha256 wins; every file is hash-checked whichever copy it came from. His home-network drive (a large external disk on his own network, 11/23 12:44 AM) is added later as one more 'folder' entry wherever he wants it in the order. The release repository must be private (Atrium is public); it is empty until Jake picks it (installer/DECISION_saved_copy_private_repo_2026-11-23.md), and an empty one is skipped with a row saying so. Read by saved_copies.py.
